Akanksha Chamola confirms divorce from Gaurav Khanna, cites differing parenthood views

Actress Akanksha Chamola has confirmed her separation and divorce from actor Gaurav Khanna. Chamola stated that they have been living separately for a year and cited differing views on parenthood as a key reason for the split, with Khanna wanting children and Chamola preferring to remain child-free. She also expressed a desire to enjoy her newfound freedom.
